trap.label: comodidades
trap.wrong: The flat has many commodities, like a gym and a pool.
trap.right: The flat has many amenities, like a gym and a pool.
trap.why: “Comodidades” lembra commodities, mas esta palavra são mercadorias (como soja). As facilidades de um imóvel são amenities.

fix.wrong: This period property have original features.
fix.right: This period property has original features.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com in need of: “It needs modernization.”
rewrite.answer: It is in need of modernization.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com generous: “The rooms are very large.”
rewrite.answer: The rooms are of generous proportions.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com subject to contract: “No binding agreement yet.”
rewrite.answer: The sale is subject to contract.
